name.local: ガイアックス スタートアップスタジオ

aka: 株式会社ガイアックス

strategy.thesis: Whole-company startup studio: the entire firm operates as a studio that continuously produces young founders, providing capital plus hands-on business development, engineering (no-code MVPs) and back-office support. ~80% of founders are students or within three years of graduation.

program.eligibility: Aspiring founders, frequently current students or recent graduates; ideation through growth phases

summary.en: Tokyo-listed Gaiax (founded 1999) reorganized its whole company into a startup studio that continuously incubates and co-founds startups, investing up to ¥20M per founder alongside business-dev, engineering and back-office support. ~40 companies backed, 4 IPOs.
summary.local: 1999年設立・東証上場のガイアックスが会社全体を『スタートアップスタジオ』化。起業家に最大2,000万円を出資し、事業開発・エンジニアリング・バックオフィスを伴走支援。約40社に出資し4社が上場。

strategy.thesis: Hakuhodo Group startup studio applying a 'Hollywood studio' model to new-business creation: idea creation → business design → prototype → full development → growth, with hands-on investment, co-founding and spinouts; growing deeptech focus (university research seeds).

summary.en: quantum is the Hakuhodo Group's startup studio (independent entity since April 2016). It co-creates products, businesses and ventures via incubation, hands-on investment, co-founding and spinouts, increasingly focused on deeptech and university research seeds. In 2019 it became Asia's first member of the Global Startup Studio Network.
summary.local: 博報堂グループのスタートアップスタジオ（2016年4月に独立法人化）。インキュベーション、ハンズオン投資、共同創業、スピンアウトで新規事業・ベンチャーを連続創出。ディープテック領域を強化し、大企業・大学約75〜100社と協業。

strategy.thesis: Described as 'the industry's first omnidirectional startup studio,' ZERO1000 Ventures co-creates ventures with entrepreneurs, leveraging Relic Group's assets from 5,000+ new-business development projects, with no restriction on business domain so founders can focus fully on building.

summary.en: Run by privately-held new-business firm Relic, ZERO1000 Ventures is positioned as Japan's first 'omnidirectional' startup studio. It co-creates ventures with founders across any domain, drawing on Relic's 5,000+ new-business projects, and has helped build companies like ecbo, HEART CLOSET and Famione.

strategy.thesis: A domain-specialized venture studio supporting pre-founding entrepreneurs (and startups within one year of incorporation), partnering with major Japanese corporations to co-create sector-focused startups (e.g., construction/real-estate programs that have spun out multiple companies).

program.eligibility: Pre-founding entrepreneurs and startups within one year of incorporation

summary.en: 01Booster, a long-running Japanese venture-creation partner (also operating accelerators and a co-working community), runs 01Booster Studio — a domain-specialized venture studio that backs pre-founding entrepreneurs and co-creates startups with major corporate partners (e.g., a construction-sector program that created three startups).

strategy.thesis: An entertainment-domain startup studio (music, video, publishing, fashion) whose primary work is 'launching businesses together with entrepreneurs'; combines entertainment with technology and partners with mixi's Entertainment Fund for investment.

program.eligibility: Aspiring founders building entertainment x technology startups

It runs a 3-month incubation program and built ventures such as FAVER and the music NFT marketplace .mura.

name.local: Sun* スタートアップスタジオ

strategy.thesis: Tokyo-listed digital/creative firm Sun* runs a startup studio that internalizes the critical functions (capital, talent, business design, marketing, engineers, designers) and co-creates ventures end-to-end, assigning CTOs and senior engineers and taking equity rather than only mentoring or funding.

program.eligibility: Founders / corporates building digital ventures who pair with Sun* project teams

application.how_to_apply: Engage via Sun* development / startup studio service

summary.en: Sun* (TSE-listed since 2020, founded 2012) launched its startup studio on June 17, 2019. Unlike a VC or accelerator, it internalizes capital, talent, business design, marketing and 1,500+ engineers/creators, co-creating ventures end-to-end and taking equity — building companies such as Tenanta and HARUTAKA.
summary.local: 2012年創業・2020年東証マザーズ上場のSun*が2019年6月17日にスタートアップスタジオを開始。資本・人材・事業設計・マーケティング・1,500名超のエンジニア/クリエイターを内製化し、エクイティを取って事業を一気通貫で共創。TenantaやHARUTAKA等を創出。

strategy.thesis: Takes business ideas and technology seeds from large corporations and university research institutions, then assembles cross-disciplinary teams to build globally-scalable startups; runs sector programs such as an Energy Revolution Lab and a food/agriculture program.

program.eligibility: Researchers, corporate professionals, freelancers and part-time entrepreneurs joining cross-disciplinary venture teams

application.how_to_apply: Join a Spirete sector program (e.g., Energy Revolution Lab) via the website

summary.en: Founded 2019 in Tokyo and led by Yasuharu Watanabe, Spirete is a deeptech-leaning startup studio that takes ideas and technology seeds from large corporations and universities and builds globally-scalable startups with cross-disciplinary teams. It runs sector programs (e.g., a food/agriculture program with ¥50M backing) with partners like J-Power, Yanmar and JT.
summary.local: 2019年に渡邊康晴氏が東京で設立。大企業や大学研究機関からビジネスアイデア・技術シーズを受け取り、異分野人材を集めてグローバルスケールのスタートアップを創出するディープテック志向のスタートアップスタジオ。食農プログラムでは5,000万円規模の支援。J-Power・ヤンマー・JT等と連携。

name.local: BEENOS スタートアップスタジオ

strategy.thesis: Often cited as the first to adopt the startup-studio model in Japan: co-founds startups from zero alongside entrepreneurs, then invests in seed/mid-stage companies and engages deeply in their operations. Hiro Maeda ran the incubation arm before launching the BEENEXT fund.

summary.en: BEENOS (formerly netprice) is widely cited as the first Japanese organization to adopt the startup-studio model, co-founding startups from zero with entrepreneurs and then investing at seed/mid-stage with deep operational involvement. Its incubation arm was led by Hiro Maeda, who later launched the BEENEXT fund with founder Teruhide Sato.
summary.local: BEENOS（旧ネットプライス）は、日本で初めてStartup Studioモデルを採用したとされる組織。起業家と共にゼロからスタートアップを立ち上げ、シード〜ミドルに投資しオペレーションに深く関与。インキュベーション部門は前田ヒロ氏が統括し、後に佐藤輝英氏とBEENEXTを立ち上げた。
